auth.adminIntro: This is a separate login from the staff and customer account areas.
auth.staffIntro: This is a separate login from the customer account area.
auth.resetIntro: For admin and staff accounts. We’ll email you a link that works once, for 1 hour.
auth.linkExpiredIntro: This link is invalid, has already been used or has expired.
auth.linkExpiredPassword: Invites last 24 hours and reset links 1 hour. Ask an admin for a new invite, or <link>request a new reset link</link>.
auth.linkExpiredEmail: Sign in and request the change again from your account settings.
auth.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence works well.
auth.confirmEmailIntro: Change the sign-in email for {name} from {from} to {to}?

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Business overview across staff, orders, and support.
dashboard.liveOnly: Revenue, orders, charts, top countries and conversion count live (real-payment) orders only — Stripe test-mode and demo orders are excluded.
dashboard.attentionIntro: The customer paid but doesn’t have a working eSIM yet. Retry resumes provisioning where it stopped. If you refunded the customer or solved it another way, Remove takes it off this list (the order itself is kept).
dashboard.retryConfirm: This will buy a real plan from Transatel for order ORD-{id}. Continue?
dashboard.confirmRefunded: Mark ORD-{id} as refunded? We’ll check with Stripe that the payment was fully refunded. The order stays in Orders, marked refunded, and no longer counts as revenue.
dashboard.confirmResolved: Remove ORD-{id} from this list? Use this if the customer was helped another way. The order stays in Orders as a paid order.
dashboard.revenueNote: What customers paid, incl. the 5% taxes & fees line
dashboard.costNoteMissing: Transatel wholesale, delivered eSIMs only. {count, plural, one {# delivered order has} other {# delivered orders have}} no known cost.
dashboard.feesNotFetched: ({count, plural, one {# fee} other {# fees}} not fetched yet)
dashboard.marginNote: Profit ÷ revenue, before Stripe fees and VAT

orders.title: Orders
orders.intro: Every order, newest first. A customer page link shows that customer’s eSIM QR code — treat it like a password and only send it to the customer.
orders.costIntro: Cost is the Transatel wholesale price saved when the order was placed, counted once the eSIM is delivered. Profit is the amount paid (incl. the 5% taxes & fees line) minus that cost, before Stripe fees and VAT.
orders.searchPlaceholder: Order number, name, email, plan, ICCID or MSISDN
orders.limit: Showing the {limit} newest matching orders — refine your search to see older ones.
orders.resendConfirm: Email the private order link for ORD-{id} to {email} again?

sims.title: SIMs
sims.intro: Every SIM we’ve sold, with its last known status from Transatel. Statuses are cached — use Refresh to re-read them (read-only requests; nothing changes on Transatel’s side). Last refreshed: {date}.
sims.searchPlaceholder: Email, order number, ICCID or MSISDN
sims.limited: Only the {limit} most recent sales are loaded.
sims.destinationNote: “Destination” is the country the plan was bought for; the billing country comes from Stripe and the last country from Transatel.

simDetail.openQr: Open (shows the QR code — only share with the customer)

staff.title: Staff Directory
staff.intro: Every staff and admin account, with today’s shift status. New people are invited by email and choose their own password.
staff.broadcastPlaceholder: Write an announcement for the whole team…
staff.attachForEveryone: Attach as task for every staff member

invite.intro: They’ll get an email with a link to choose their own password. The link works once and expires in 24 hours.
invite.name: Name

rowActions.resendConfirm: Send {name} a new invite link? Earlier links stop working.
rowActions.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {name}? They’ll be signed out and won’t be able to sign in. Their history is kept, and you can reactivate them later.
rowActions.reactivateConfirm: Reactivate {name}? They’ll be able to sign in again.
rowActions.deleteConfirm: Delete {name} permanently? They’ll disappear from the staff lists and can’t be reactivated. Their past shifts, tasks and messages are kept, and their email address can be invited again.

admins.title: Admins
admins.intro: Everyone who can open this admin panel. Accounts are deactivated, never deleted. You can’t deactivate yourself or the last active admin.
admins.activityIntro: The latest 50 sign-ins, invites and account changes for admin and staff accounts.

actions.order_attention_dismissed: removed an order from the attention list

account.title: Account settings
account.nameIntro: Shown in the admin panel, the staff portal and the account activity log.
account.name: Name
account.emailIntro: We’ll send a confirmation link to the new address; your email only changes once you open it. Your current address gets a notice when it changes.
account.passwordIntro: You’ll stay signed in here and be signed out everywhere else.

portal.title: Staff portal
portal.intro: Here’s your shift status for today.
portal.noTasks: No tasks assigned to you yet.
portal.messagesIntro: Direct messages from admin, and team-wide announcements.

msg.emailNotSetUp: Email isn’t set up on this server yet (RESEND_API_KEY / EMAIL_FROM), so this link can’t be sent.
msg.alreadyInvited: That person has already been invited — use “Resend invite” on their row.
msg.accountExists: An account with that email already exists.
msg.tooManyInvites: Too many invites to that address in the last hour. Try again later.
msg.inviteEmailFailed: The account was created but the invite email failed ({error}). Fix the email settings, then use “Resend invite”.
msg.inviteSent: Invite sent to {email}. The link expires in 24 hours.
msg.notWaitingInvite: That account isn’t waiting for an invite.
msg.newInviteSent: New invite sent to {email}. Earlier links no longer work.
msg.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in an hour.
msg.linkInvalidNew: This link is invalid, has already been used or has expired. Ask for a new one.
msg.passwordSet: Your password is set — you can sign in now.
msg.passwordChangedSignIn: Your password has been changed — sign in with the new one.
msg.resetSent: If there’s an account for that email, we’ve sent it a reset link. It expires in 1 hour.
msg.resetNotSetUp: Password reset emails aren’t set up on this server yet. Ask another admin, or see the recovery steps in scripts/README.md.
msg.tooManyResets: Too many reset requests. Try again in an hour.
msg.tooManyWrong: Too many wrong passwords. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
msg.samePassword: Choose a password different from your current one.
msg.passwordChanged: Password changed. You’ve been signed out on your other devices.
msg.emailTaken: Another account already uses that email address.
msg.confirmEmailFailed: The confirmation email couldn’t be sent ({error}).
msg.confirmEmailSent: We’ve sent a confirmation link to {email}. Your email changes once you open it (within 24 hours).
msg.linkInvalidEmail: This link is invalid, has already been used or has expired. Request the change again from your account settings.
msg.emailTakenMeantime: Another account started using that email address in the meantime, so it wasn’t changed.
msg.emailChanged: Your email address is now {email}. Use it the next time you sign in.
msg.nameLength: Enter a name of 1 to 100 characters.

accounts.selfDeactivate: You can’t deactivate your own account.
accounts.lastAdmin: This is the last active admin account, so it can’t be deactivated.
accounts.selfDelete: You can’t delete your own account.
accounts.deleteNotDeactivated: Only a deactivated account can be deleted. Deactivate it first.

login.tooManyFailed: Too many failed attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again, or reset your password.
login.deactivated: This account has been deactivated. Ask an admin if you need access again.
login.adminOnly: This sign-in is for admin accounts only.

fees.fetched: Fetched {count, plural, one {# fee} other {# fees}}.

dismiss.hasEsim: This order already has its eSIM.

dismiss.partialRefund: Stripe shows only a partial refund. Refund the rest in Stripe, or use “Resolved another way”.
dismiss.noRefund: Stripe doesn’t show a refund for this payment yet. Refund it in Stripe first, then try again.
dismiss.checkError: Couldn’t check the refund with Stripe: {error}
dismiss.markedRefunded: Marked refunded and removed from the list.

orderEmail.unexpected: Email not sent (unexpected error — see server logs).
